name: Archangel Michael
alt: Archangel Michael with wings and a sword, painted by Guido Reni.
lore: The first reference. Wings, a grounded stance and a blade held with intention. For me: protect what matters, then do the work.
detail: a wing following the shoulder, a grounded stance, a restrained blade

name: The Fallen Angel
alt: The intense gaze behind a raised arm in Alexandre Cabanel’s The Fallen Angel.
lore: Not just an angel: that look under the arm. The tension between vulnerability and defiance is the part I want to keep.
detail: an intense gaze partly concealed by a forearm, one small tear, quiet tension

name: Anakin
alt: Anakin Skywalker costume reference, photographed by Doug Kline.
lore: The drive to become more, and the danger of letting fear choose the direction. A reminder to keep the fire without letting it make every decision.
detail: a divided portrait, a watchful eye, a very small ember-red accent
credit: Doug Kline / popculturegeek.com · cosplay reference · CC BY 2.0 · resized WebP

name: The ember monkey
alt: An original engraved monkey warrior with a staff and a flame at the end of its tail.
line: curious enough to start. stubborn enough to evolve.
lore: My Monferno-shaped instinct: restless energy, training and evolution. This original monkey-warrior study also nods to Sun Wukong. A candidate for my own emblem, not a final tattoo.
detail: an agile monkey, a curling tail with one small flame, a staff and wind-worn cloth

name: Diogenes
alt: A study of Diogenes by Jean-Léon Gérôme.
line: keep the lantern. lose the performance.
lore: The philosopher behind the lantern. What I take from him: ask the uncomfortable question, need less, and stop mistaking status for substance.
detail: a weathered philosopher, a small lantern and deliberate empty space

name: The Legion
alt: The Corvus crow as a tiny general.
line: build something people can stand behind.
lore: The general is only one figure. The standard-bearer, the soldiers and the people showing up make the story. That is the Corvus part of this board.
detail: a worn standard, a small formation and a crow watching from above
